evaluator.name: Codex plus deterministic validators and in-app browser proof

contractChecks.evidence: Hard circular geometry, no decorative chassis effects, canonical white Wings, 0.39 ratio and 48px marked minimum are explicit and verified.
Source master, exact static twin and parametric runtime are labelled separately; protected hashes match all five approved cores.
One browser-mounted live focal object and static repeated family make motion allocation observable and enforceable.
Four representative viewports, reduced-motion mode and disabled-WebGL mode retain circle geometry, exact fallback and zero horizontal overflow.
Canonical package authority is true for the bounded disc scope while sphere, cards, homepage, Figma and consumers remain excluded.
After the approval scope was explained explicitly, Olli approved all stated disc rules; DEC-DISC-EXPRESSION-001 records canonical 1.0.0.

qualityDimensions.evidence: One fixed silhouette and mark ratio create recognisable product geometry without generic icon tiles or glow.
Five equal static cores differ only through already approved gradient and literal copy.
One live focal allowance prevents competing gradient motion and makes the static state intentional.
Exact twins, explicit channel states and failure behaviour do not depend on WebGL for recognition.
Immutable inputs are hash-protected and the candidate claims no production, consumer or adjacent-expression authority.

notes: Machine, visual and informed human review are complete. The proof typography was corrected to canonical Geist and Inter. Disc expression 1.0.0 is canonical for its declared scope and EXP-02 is at review candidate.
